'''Model X''' was a model of [[Heavy blaster pistol/Legends|heavy blaster pistol]] of the "superheavy" designation, and was produced by [[Caliban (manufacturer)/Legends|Caliban]].<ref name="AEG" />

==Characteristics==
Packing as much power as possible into its relatively short range of sixty meters,<ref name="Scoundrels" /> the weapon was was essentially identical in power to the [[T-6 heavy blaster pistol|T-6]],<ref name="AEG output">''[[Arms & Equipment Guide]]'': Based on identical attack stats of 3D8+2, both weapons share the same damage output.</ref> and shared the same "superheavy" classification due to its abnormally heavy punch.<ref name="AEG" />

Despite its power the Model X was somewhat fragile, and required a high amount of maintenance and calibration as a result. [[SoroSuub Corporation/Legends|SoroSuub Corporation]] saw potential in the design, though, and when the company acquired [[Caliban (manufacturer)/Legends|Caliban]] from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], SoroSuub redesigned the Model X into the slightly less powerful, but sturdier, [["Renegade" heavy blaster pistol/Legends|Renegade heavy blaster pistol]].<ref name="AEG" />

==History==
[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] temporarily used a Caliban Model X, admiring the weapon for its incredible power, even going so far as to compare it to a larger [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] in terms of stopping power.<ref name="Scoundrels" />
